definitions.explanation: Describes a person or action characterized by paying close attention and taking care to avoid mistakes or danger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{注意深|ちゅういぶか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{注意深|ちゅういぶか}く⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てた→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧。
examples.english: I carefully read the instructions before assembling it.

examples.japanese: {注意深|ちゅういぶか}い⟦{観察|かんさつ}→観察：02558_kansatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{異変|いへん}→異変：15754_ihen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気付|きづ}く→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to careful observation, I was able to notice even small irregularities.

notes:
{注意深|ちゅういぶか}い is an i-adjective meaning careful or attentive. Formed from ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (caution) + ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep).

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {注意深|ちゅういぶか}く
- Negative: {注意深|ちゅういぶか}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注意深|ちゅういぶか}く⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧: to observe carefully
- {注意深|ちゅういぶか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a careful person
- {注意深|ちゅういぶか}く⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read carefully
- {注意深|ちゅういぶか}く⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose carefully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧: cautious, prudent (na-adjective; emphasizes deliberation before acting)
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧: careful, polite (na-adjective; emphasizes thoroughness and precision)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. In casual speech, ⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ (to be careful) or ⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧ are more common.
